name: Southern-Fried Gaming Expo
blurb: An arcade, pinball and tabletop gaming expo in Atlanta with 400+ machines, console systems, RPGs, wrestling and live music each July.

editions.venue: Renaissance Atlanta Waverly Hotel & Convention Center
editions.evidence: Homepage: 'JULY 16-18, 2027 Atlanta, GA - Marriott Renaissance Waverly' and 'the thirteenth-annual Southern-Fried Gaming Expo ... once again at the beautiful Renaissance Atlanta Waverly Hotel and Convention Center'

notes: The guest page's own URL/title says '2026 Special Guests' even though the site-wide banner and all date text say July 2027 (the organizer's edition label runs a year behind the calendar date); the page is clearly current for the upcoming show since it has a live 'Cancellations' section. Three cancelled guests (David Crane, Garry Kitchen, Ted DiBiase) were excluded per the skip-cancelled rule. This year's non-cancelled 'Special Guests' are all under the page's 'Music & Entertainment' heading (bands, a keytar musician, a comedy troupe, and a wrestling promotion) rather than classic arcade/game-industry guests. Two stylised all-caps band names (Y'ALL'RE, LGHTRS) were normalised to title case per the naming rule. No organizer legal name was found on the homepage. Guest-freshness recheck (verify-06, 2026-10-05): confirmed current despite the '2026-special-guests' URL slug — /2027-special-guests/ 404s (no newer page exists to supersede it), the page still carries a live Cancellations section and the same 14 Music & Entertainment acts, and the homepage still counts toward 'JULY 16–18, 2027' ('thirteenth-annual'). REFUTED (refute-04, 2026-10-05): a fresh render shows the page's own <title> reads '2026 Special Guests - Southern-Fried Gaming Expo | July 16-18, 2027' -- i.e. the guest content itself is explicitly dated 2026 even as the site chrome shows next year's countdown. Web search confirms SFGE 2026 actually ran July 31-August 2, 2026 at this same venue, ending just 2 months ago -- squarely the 'previous edition ended in the last 6 months' staleness case, and a live Cancellations section on a show still 9+ months out is itself a staleness sign, not a freshness one. No guest or act has any filename, alt text or date tying them to the 2027 show specifically. Guests reset to none-yet; lineup and textOnlyGuests removed until a genuine 2027 announcement appears (the 404ing /2027-special-guests/ URL means none exists yet).
